selectLanguageDescription: Khetha ulimi lwenqubo yokufaka kanye nolimi oluzenzakonakele lesayithi.
verifyRequirementsDescription: Qinisekisa ukuthi isimo se-seva sakho sihambisana nezidingo zokusebenzisa i-HAX.
allRequirementsMet: Zonke izidingo sezihambisene. Ungaqhubeka kulenye isinyathelo.
configureSystemDescription: Setha i-akhawunti yakho yomphathi walesayithi elisha le-HAX.
passwordHelp: Shiya sikhala ngokuzenzakalela kwamaphasiwedi akhuselekile, noma faka imikhondo engu-10+ enosonhlamvukazi munye nenani elilodwa.
saveCredentialsWarning: Kubalulekile: Gcina lezi zitifikethi manje. Leliyona kuphela isikhathi ezoze ziboniswe.
languageHelp: Thayipha igama, igama lomdabu noma ikhodi.
usernameHelp: Izinhlamvu, izinombolo, ichashazi, udeshi kanye nomugqa ongaphansi.
versionAfterSignIn: Inguqulo ye-HAXcms nezindlela ezigcwele zeseva ziboniswa kumphathi wesistimu ngemva kokungena.
foreverTitle: I-HAX yakho ingeyakho, kuze kube phakade
foreverFiles: Amasayithi akho angamafayela avamile ku-_sites, alandelelwa yi-git kusukela ngosuku lokuqala.
foreverStandards: Yakhelwe phezu kwamazinga ewebhu, ngakho okwenzayo kuqhubeka kusebenza njengoba i-HAXcms ibuyekezwa.
foreverPortable: Thatha isayithi uye nayo noma kuphi: isebenza ku-HAXcms ku-PHP noma ku-Node, noma njengamafayela amile.
foreverPillar: Kuyasimama: kwakhelwe ukuhlala isikhathi eside, kulula emhlabeni.
tvArtCredit: Ubuciko be-Future Traveler kusuka ku-haxtheweb/art. I-TV ibukeka ngendlela efanayo ekukhanyeni nasebumnyameni.
padNote: I-HAX Blocks esiteshini 2: jaha izimbangi ezintathu ngamabhlokhi e-HAX. U-A uyabamba (noma ushaye imbangi eseduze nawe), u-B ubuyisa elilodwa, u-Select uxuba kabusha umlwi wakho, u-Start uyashicilela. Ikhibhodi yakho nayo iyasebenza: imicibisholo, u-A no-B bakhanyisa inkinobho abayicindezelayo.
tipDifference: Amakhasi akho ayi-HTML elandela amazinga ewebhu emafayeleni avamile ongumnikazi wawo, alandelelwa yi-git. Cishe wonke amasayithi akhiwe nge-HAX kusukela ngo-2020 asasebenza nanamuhla, futhi isayithi ihamba phakathi kwe-HAXcms ku-PHP, ku-Node noma ekusingathweni okumile njengoba injalo. Yakhelwe ukuhlala isikhathi eside, ilula emhlabeni.
tipFilesTitle: Letha amafayela akho uwenze abe yi-HAX
tipFiles: Ngemva kokufaka, u-Ngenisa kudeshibhodi uguqula lokhu kube isayithi ye-HAX ongayihlela, uyixube kabusha futhi uyithathe uye nayo noma kuphi.
tipSites: Khomba u-Ngenisa ekhelini lesayithi bese amakhasi ayo engena njengamakhasi namabhlokhi e-HAX.
tipBooks: Izincwadi zokufunda ezivulekile nama-repo e-docs-as-code aba yisayithi ye-HAX uhlaka lwazo lungaphazamiseki.
tipPassword: Isinyathelo sokugcina sibonisa ukungena kwakho okusha kanye kuphela. Kugcine kumphathi wamaphasiwedi ngaphambi kokuqala i-HAXcms.
